title: Special Order for SFC Contract Services, Inc., ex parte. — SFC Contract Services, Inc. ex parte. In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8320. THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED LPSC No. 8320 hereby is, cancelled.

LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION


                            SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 58-2026


                              SFC CONTRACT SERVICES, INC.
                                           EX PARTE


                         In re: Request for cancellation of LPSC No. 8320
On information and belief that the carrier wishes to close LPSC No. 8320 per a notarized affidavit
received   on   August 13, 2026, it is therefore ORDERED that LPSC No.        8320 held   by SFC
Contract Services, Inc. is hereby CANCELLED and REVOKED, with all outstanding fees and
fines owed the Commission to be paid by the carrier in the event of any reinstatement.
